attempts.prompt:
Create ONE finished graphic-novel cover for SOLSTICE EVENING BELL. Portrait 9:16, target 864 x 1536 pixels. This is a single cover image, not a comic page, collage or character sheet.

REFERENCE IMAGE 1 ROLE: use the attached original cover ONLY for the adult woman's facial identity, long silver hair, white armored dress and segmented silver-armor inspiration. Do not copy its composition, painterly rendering, lettering, giant spaceships, ornate fantasy coast, luminous web, apparent bell count, head tiara or external chest jewel. Redraw the entire scene in the precise comic rendering described below. The factual description below controls any conflict with the reference.

STYLE: crisp confident BLACK INK contours, heavier outer silhouettes, broad SATURATED FLAT COLOR fills, clean HARD-EDGED shadows in only a few tonal steps, clear stylized adult anatomy and expressive face. Graphic, forceful and readable. Near-black ink #11151B; midnight #102B56; strong storm blue #196FB4; restrained cyan #22A9C7; silver #C9DBE6; near-white #FFFDF4; pale-yellow #FFE783 used sparingly in the title treatment. Keep natural skin color. No watercolor, soft painted modeling, dense hatching, paper texture, grain, photorealism, glossy 3D, gradients across faces or copied ornate lettering.

STORY MOMENT: the opening invasion above an evacuated modern-like western bay at night, before Solstice attacks. One adult woman is the sole living defender. She is clean, dry and uninjured. There are no helpers, donor spirits or living donor women. Solstice is suspended in the air above the bay, rather than standing on a rock or on water. Show a powerful readable three-quarter portrait with enough of her armored body and flowing white dress to make the silhouette unmistakable. Her face turns upward toward the host with steady resolve; both armored hands begin to rise. Her long silver hair moves in the high air. Preserve the white armored dress, articulated silver-and-white bodice, silver pauldrons, segmented forearm and hand armor. Opaque armor fully covers the sternum. NO head crown or tiara. NO external chest gem. NO visible central jewel or floating chest object.

CRITICAL CHIME COUNT: exactly TWELVE intact separate silver bell-like chimes form a loose elongated orbital halo around Solstice. Stage SIX clearly separated chimes on the left and SIX on the right at staggered heights; each is fully visible and individually countable, none hidden by hair, figure, frame or lettering. One of the twelve is slightly smaller. These are nonliving equipment, not souls or tiny people. Do not add decorative extra bells anywhere. The thirteenth tone belongs to her thumb-sized CENTRAL RESONATOR, which is completely HIDDEN beneath her sternum armor: it is not a thirteenth orbiting chime and must not be visible. No broken chimes, no burnt silver, no wounds. No luminous net or geometric energy lattice. No attack beam: the opening chord has not happened yet.

INVASION AND PLACE: one stationary black seam very far above the bay in the starry sky, with EIGHT distinct descending wedge formations. Each wedge is made of many tiny separate roughly HUMAN-SIZED, featureless nonliving machine shells with FOLDING VANES. Render the host as dense formations of small individual silhouettes separated by air, not eight solid triangular vessels. No giant capital ships, airplane wings, cockpit windows, pilots or living monsters. Their small apparent size and the vast sky communicate distance; do not put an enormous close machine beside the woman. Beneath her is an evacuated modern-like bay with simple concrete northern breakwater at image left and southern breakwater at image right, offshore shallow sea shelf between their approaches, empty harbor roads and a distant eastern ridge on the far horizon. Black autumn cloud towers below the high fight, one night sky. No fantasy towers or ornate palaces, no crowds, no allied aircraft, no batteries, no rescue force. Keep the coastal forms subordinate to the clear figure and title.

COMPOSITION AND LETTERING: design one strong heroic silhouette and a clearly countable twelve-chime halo, with the eight distant wedge formations and seam above. Reserve an uncluttered dark title field low on the cover. Title is the ONLY readable text, exactly these two lines:
SOLSTICE
EVENING BELL
Use very readable bold condensed UPPERCASE comic lettering, near-white with a strong black outline and a restrained pale-yellow accent, approximately 96-112 px letter height at 864 px canvas width. Keep every title letter inside a minimum 48 px safe outer margin. Do not cover her face, hands, any chime or essential armor with text. Do not copy the original cover's fine serif typography. No subtitle, author name, credits, issue number, publisher mark, watermark, logo, speech balloons, caption boxes or sheet headings. Keep the figure, all twelve chimes and complete title within the final 9:16 portrait; do not crop them.

Read left to right, top to bottom: one wide top panel, two equal side-by-side middle panels, one wide bottom panel. All are strong simple rectangular black borders with 24px white gutters and 40px outer safety. Target row heights 336, 448, 624px. No montage, inset or extra panel.

INPUT ROLES: image1 accepted SOLSTICE character sheet is primary identity, armor and bold flat-ink rendering. Use only her CLEAN UNINJURED upper-row state: one adult woman with long silver hair, pale natural skin, blue-gray eyes, white armored dress, articulated white/silver pauldrons and gauntlets. Ignore lower injury states and all sheet words. Image2 is the single western bay: preserve north breakwater LEFT, south RIGHT, empty right harbor road and EASTERN inland ridge; simplify tiny water detail to broad strong ink shapes. Image3 crown sheet supplies bell shapes and the one hidden sternum focus, not a cutaway composition. Carry NO sheet labels into the page.

STYLE: crisp heavy black silhouettes and confident internal contours, saturated midnight and strong blue fields, hard-edged two-step shadows, near-white silver armor, yellow narration boxes with black outlines, BOLD CONDENSED UPPERCASE COMIC lettering. No painted rendering, gradients, washed texture, hatching, gloss or 3D. Use 40-44px lettering at 1024 width, generous line spacing and box padding. Exact words below, no additions. If text is long, wrap at natural spaces in a broad box; keep it readable rather than reducing letter size. Panel1 caption fits two/three lines across; middle captions four/five short lines; bottom caption two/three broad lines.

PANEL1 (top wide): High oblique view from offshore WEST into the empty western bay. The two concrete arms surround ONE bay: north on left, south on right, shallow sea shelf across outer approaches, eastern ridge far inland. A single tiny white silhouette of Solstice is suspended over the bay, alone. Low ordinary storm clouds over the western water, stars visible above. Empty harbor road behind right breakwater has several simple glowing red directional evacuation arrows; no words on these road arrows. Place a yellow caption high in clear sky, without covering Solstice:
"THE INSTRUMENTS WENT BLIND NINE SECONDS BEFORE THE SKY OPENED."

PANEL2 (middle LEFT): Close on the ordinary dark rectangular public hazard board mounted beside that EMPTY southern road. Modern utilitarian structure, no person or vehicle. Its red luminous block letters show clearly through minimal static; static must not obscure any word. Compose the board frontally enough to read, with a narrow empty road margin. The black board contains ONLY:
"ULTRAHUMAN ASSETS IN EXCLUSION ZONE: 1"
Wrap sign into three/four readable lines. This is diegetic RED sign lettering, not a narration box. Above the board, a separate yellow caption contains ONLY:
"SHE HAD ORDERED EVERY BATTERY AND AIRCRAFT BEYOND THE EASTERN RIDGE."
Keep caption and board separate and fully readable. Never show the withdrawn batteries/aircraft.

PANEL3 (middle RIGHT): Tight chest-and-armored-hand detail of the SAME Solstice. Her right hand rests naturally across the UNBROKEN, OPAQUE white sternum armor. Coherent wrist and five gauntleted fingers. She is unhurt; no blood, dents, dirt or torn clothes. The thumb-sized focus is completely hidden UNDER the armor, NO exterior jewel, glow, seam opening or cutaway. Background dark blue night, a few silver hair strands. Yellow caption in clear upper space:
"THE FORCE WAS HERS. THE CROWN GAVE IT PRECISION."

PANEL4 (bottom wide): Medium-wide front three-quarter view of the SAME adult Solstice suspended alone, clean and dry, gaze lifted into unbroken starry night. Calm gravity, not an attack pose; hands relaxed after the preceding sternum touch. Her white dress and long silver hair move gently. EXACTLY TWELVE separate silver chimes form a loose uneven halo: SIX clearly separated on image LEFT and SIX on RIGHT, all fully visible and countable, with C9 uniquely smaller. No printed C labels. Keep each side's six staggered vertically and well separated from hair, hands, caption and borders. Nothing connects them: no cords, strings, halo ring, web, beam or electrical arc. The central focus remains hidden beneath opaque chest armor; there is no thirteenth floating bell and NO head tiara. One wide yellow caption in clear lower space, not overlapping any bell or her hands:
"TWELVE LAST SPELLS, FREELY MADE. THE THIRTEENTH TONE WAS HER OWN."

Exact current instant: BEFORE the sky opens. No rupture, portal, invaders, aircraft, armies, donors, donor faces/ghosts, additional people, attacks, magical planes, active mesh, wounds, weapon or blood anywhere. The twelve chimes are nonliving equipment. All scene figures are the same one living adult across separate panels. No lettering outside the four specified narration captions and the single specified sign. Keep all anatomy, bells and text within borders.

Create ONE object-design reference sheet for a roughly HUMAN-SIZED NONLIVING INVASION FRAME from a comic. Landscape1536x1024, plain near-white background. The sole attached character sheet is for bold clean BLACK INK, broad FLAT fills and HARD-EDGED shadow rendering, plus approximate human proportion context ONLY. Do not draw the woman, armor costume, person, ghost, donor, injuries or character-sheet labels.

This is ONE machine type seen in several technical views, not several creatures or an army. Design a roughly upright human-sized smooth featureless dark shell with slender FOLDING VANES hinged around its central body. The closed shell is compact; the vanes open outward into a distinct angular silhouette and can fold back against it. No face, eyes, cockpit, pilot, mouth, skull, organic tissue, humanoid hands/feet, decorative humanoid armor or weapons turret. It is not a giant spacecraft. Use charcoal/navy body fills, restrained storm-blue planes and thin near-white hard edge accents, no glossy chrome or painted modeling.

Across the top/main area show three separated views of exactly this SAME object design:
1 LEFT: compact shell with vanes folded closed, full height visible. A simple vertical scale rule next to it is labeled APPROXIMATE HUMAN SCALE, with no person silhouette and no numerical height claims.
2 CENTER: front three-quarter full object with its same folding vanes open. Keep it visually the same size and machine identity as view1. Show real hinge geometry and coherent connections; no floating unrelated blades.
3 RIGHT: side view of the same open frame, showing shell depth and hinged vanes, not a different machine type.

Bottom LEFT: a close technical detail of the shell's small NEEDLE APERTURE with one thin metal needle projectile just emerging, its straight path indicated by a short plain arrow. This is a metal needle, not beam/flame/missile/ammunition belt.
Bottom RIGHT: an enlarged cropped VANES INTERLOCKING detail where one vane of this frame fits against a single cropped neighboring frame's vane/shell edge. This demonstrates nonliving synchronized lattice geometry, not a giant combined creature, living grasp or magical rope. Only necessary partial neighboring geometry, not another full frame view or an army.

Use confident heavy outlines and crisp flat cel shadows like the accepted character reference. White gaps separate the views. Only these exact black bold condensed uppercase comic labels may appear, no C labels or story narration:
INVASION FRAME
CLOSED
OPEN
SIDE
APPROXIMATE HUMAN SCALE
NEEDLE APERTURE
VANES INTERLOCKING

Do not print duplicate labels, extra words, credits or watermarks. No battle scene, location, portal, chimes, queen, donor spirit, ally, aircraft, faces, body damage or blood. These diagrams establish geometry only; the machines are nonliving equipment. Everything must fit uncut within the single reference canvas.
